answer: Forging extra identities means posting fresh collateral per key, and a gale of duplicate registrations triggers slashing that burns the stake and forfeits reputation. Agents stake a bonded timber deposit tied to a unique verified plume signature, so each identity is rooted in scarce, costly material rather than free keys. Attackers must thus pay real, unrecoverable cost per sybil, making mass identity farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
